turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Tuesday. How is your day going so far? Did you get a chance to do any baking yesterday evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Tuesdays are always a bit busy, but I'm doing well. I didn't bake last night, but I did use my roommate's espresso maker before heading out. I brewed some espresso shots and poured them over ice and water for a cold morning drink to wake me up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, an iced drink! Tucson might be warm, but that still sounds like a crisp way to start the morning. Did you pair that with a good lunch today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I actually made a turkey and cheese sandwich using some of my homemade wild-yeast bread from over the weekend. It held up really well.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious. There's nothing like a sandwich on homemade sourdough. Did you have any downtime during your break to catch up on anything, or was it a working lunch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It was pretty quiet, so I actually put my headphones in and started listening to that investigative show about unsolved cases that my coworker recommended a while back. It's really gripping.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, the true-crime one! I remember you mentioning she recommended it. Is it living up to the hype so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. I'm already two episodes in. I had to pause it to get back to my shift at the clinic, but I'm looking forward to hearing more of it later tonight while I relax.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's always great when a recommendation hits the mark. How is Tom doing? Have the two of you had any time to look at wedding details lately, or are you taking a break from planning?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're taking a tiny break this week, but we did look at some outdoor venues for the summer. Tom's been busy with work, and I've been spending my evenings hanging out with Dash.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A break is definitely needed sometimes! How is Dash doing? Is he enjoying the January weather in Tucson?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He loves it. It's not too hot, so he's been super energetic on our walks in the park. I should probably get back to work now, but I'll talk to you later!
